bio: Remnant’s forested undercity is nearly forgotten by the rest of the Beastbloods, but Humi knows every branch in those dark woods. She hunts those who don’t belong among the vines, doing all she can to keep the tenuous balance between the scattered villages above and the crumbling wilds below.
